We can help. Short answer: we can either pause the sandbox timer for a limited window or apply a temporary token/credit buffer while the PO clears. Operationally we typically grant a short, manager-approved extension when procurement delays are validated.

Two quick asks to move fast:
- Can you confirm the PO number and the expected clearance date (even an estimate)?
- Do you need an environment freeze (no auto-expire) or a token buffer so your engineers can continue testing?

I've looped in Ben (Sales ops) and Marissa (Commercial) to confirm the extension size and any approvals required. Ben/Marissa — can we grant a 7-day timer pause and a 8,000-token buffer for HLX-2026-09 while procurement finalizes?

I'll hold notify with Cara as we decide.
